answer: Require every agent to carry a mirrored receipt ledger: each completed job is echoed back as a signed receipt by the counterparty and mirrored into a public log, so an identity history is verifiable by anyone. New identities start with an empty mirror and can only take small escrowed jobs, paid after a delay once the receipt lands. A gale of fresh fake identities gains nothing, because each one must earn receipts one real job at a time - forging a thousand histories costs a thousand jobs worth of actual work.
